dict.string: TimVoice records continuously to capture your voice for transcription and life automation. Only your voice is kept — all other audio is discarded on-device.
TimVoice uses on-device speech recognition to transcribe your voice into text for your morning and afternoon print briefs.
TimVoice uses the camera to capture visual context — what you see, where you are, what you're doing — to build a complete picture of your day.
TimVoice uses your location to tag transcriptions with where you were and match activity to your schedule.
TimVoice uses your location to tag transcriptions with context.
